title: Buzz Words
description: A phonics spelling game for kids. Hear the word, see the picture, sound it out and spell it on an ABC keyboard. A friendly voice teaches the rules as they come up: short vowels, sh and ck, magic e, vowel teams and bossy r.
controls: Tap or click letters on the ABC keyboard. Tap the picture or 🔊 to hear the word and its sounds again. Tap a sound box to hear that sound. Keyboard letters work too.
requirements: Any modern browser. Voice uses the browser's built-in speech. Saves progress in this browser.
